## Change

What user-visible behavior changes, and why?

## Verification

List the exact commands or native scenarios exercised and their observed results.
Distinguish unit/fixture checks, real app behavior and unverified environments.
For capture/ASR changes, preserve reference text and report failed gates as failures;
never substitute generated audio for a retained real-meeting benchmark.

## Risks and unverified behavior

Include compatibility, permissions, retained-audio, migration and rollback impact.
Note whether the README, changelog and release baseline need updating.

Do not attach private audio, transcripts, databases, configuration or credentials.
